name: brick
style: Stop-motion animation made entirely of small glossy plastic toy building bricks, slightly stuttering hand-animated movement, macro lens, shallow depth of field, visible studs and fingerprints on the plastic, warm practical lighting on a miniature set.
picture_style: Style: a photograph of a real miniature set built from small glossy plastic toy building bricks for a stop-motion film, macro lens, shallow depth of field, soft warm studio light.
voice: A young boy with a quiet, amazed voice

figure.draw: One small blocky plastic toy figure standing on a plain light grey brick floor against a plain grey brick wall, seen from head to foot, facing the viewer: a simple round green head with two dot eyes and a flat bored mouth, a plain blue rectangular torso, short white legs, mitten-like hands, no hair or hat. Generic toy design.
figure.is: the small blocky toy figure with a round green head, dot eyes, blue torso and white legs

bucket.draw: A plain round red plastic toy tub with no label, lid off, filled to the top with a jumble of small colourful plastic building bricks in red, blue, yellow, green and white, standing on a warm wooden bedroom floor in late afternoon sunlight, a few loose bricks scattered beside it, soft out-of-focus bed and curtain behind. Real photograph, child's-eye height.
bucket.is: the plain red toy tub filled with colourful building bricks on a wooden bedroom floor

space.draw: Outer space built entirely from toy building bricks: a black brick backdrop dotted with tiny white single-stud stars, three chunky round planets made of coloured bricks, one with a brick ring, and a small red-and-white brick rocket with a brick flame flying between them.
space.is: outer space built from bricks, with brick planets, stud stars and a small red-and-white brick rocket

clips.sound: A dull quiet room, a clock ticking, then one bright plastic click, then many quick clicks.

shots.text: In an empty grey brick room {figure} sits slumped on a single grey brick, alone and bored, grey light from a small brick window.
a close-up of the grey brick floor as one shiny red brick drops in from above, bounces twice and settles in a pool of warm light.
{figure} standing up with a wide smile as colourful bricks pop into place one by one in front of him, clicking together into a rising rainbow staircase that climbs out through the ceiling.

clips.sound: Rapid plastic clicking and snapping, a whoosh of wind, a toy rocket rumble building.

shots.text: {figure} running up the rainbow brick staircase as a tall brick castle with towers and flags assembles itself brick by brick around him against a blue brick sky.
the toy figure riding on the back of a long green brick dragon as it glides over an ocean made of rippling blue and white studs, brick clouds drifting past.
a red-and-white brick rocket snapping together around the figure and launching straight up on a column of orange and yellow brick flame, bursting through the brick clouds into {space}.

clips.sound: Deep quiet of space, a soft hum, then the warm room tone of a bedroom and bricks rattling gently in a tub.

shots.text: {space}, the small rocket drifting past a ringed brick planet while {figure} floats beside it waving happily.
the camera pulling back and up out of the brick universe until all of it is seen to be the jumble of bricks inside {bucket}, the dark space becoming the shadow between the bricks.
the red tub of bricks sitting still on the sunlit wooden floor, {figure} standing on top of the pile with one arm raised, dust motes drifting in the warm light.
